# Reviewed, intentional deviations between this build's nke-kubeadm-distro
# .deb and the production S3 golden manifests in this directory. See
# README.md for the format and the review rule. Every non-comment line must
# carry a " #" (space, then hash) reason — the parser rejects any that do
# not.
#
# removed/added/mode take a path OR a glob (path.Match semantics: "*"/"?"
# never cross a "/", so no "/**" is needed): one glob line can cover drift
# whose exact path is version-specific, e.g.
#   removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/containerd-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz
# instead of one literal line per Kubernetes patch. A glob directive counts
# as used once it matches at least one entry in the relevant comparison.
#
# Any directive may take an "optional " prefix (e.g.
#   optional added /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/k8s-base-container-images_*.tgz
# ) to mean: apply it when it matches, same as any other line, but do not
# treat matching nothing as unused. This is for per-version asymmetries a
# glob alone can't express — e.g. the production 1.36.3 package ships no
# k8s-base-container-images_*.tgz while 1.34.2 and 1.35.3 do, so the line
# above is needed for 1.36.3's comparison but would look like a stale no-op
# for the other two. "optional" is not a general escape from allowlist rot:
# use it only for a real per-version asymmetry, and say which version(s) the
# line exists for in its reason.

# The one design change behind almost every line below: dpkg now owns every
# file. The production package shipped raw upstream tarballs plus a Go
# installer that unpacked them into /usr/local and /opt at postinst time and
# generated /etc/containerd/config.toml on the node. This build extracts and
# renders all of that at package-build time, so the installer, the tarballs,
# the duplicate binaries and their checksum sidecars are gone, and the
# extracted contents appear at their FHS paths as dpkg-owned files.

# --- the installer and its bookkeeping -------------------------------------
removed /usr/bin/nke-k8s-installer  # installer deleted: dpkg lays down every file, postinst only prepares the node
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/installer  # installer deleted
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/installer.sha256  # installer deleted
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/installer  # installer deleted (per-arch copy)
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/installer.sha256  # installer deleted (per-arch copy)

# --- duplicate binaries the installer used to copy from ---------------------
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/kubeadm  # shipped once, at /usr/bin/kubeadm
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/kubeadm.sha256  # sidecar of the removed duplicate
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/kubectl  # shipped once, at /usr/bin/kubectl
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/kubectl.sha256  # sidecar of the removed duplicate
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/kubelet  # shipped once, at /usr/bin/kubelet
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/kubelet.sha256  # sidecar of the removed duplicate
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/runc.amd64  # shipped once, at /usr/sbin/runc
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/runc.amd64.sha256  # sidecar of the removed duplicate

# --- raw upstream tarballs, now extracted at build time ----------------------
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/containerd-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz  # extracted into /usr/local/bin at build time
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/containerd-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz.sha256  # sidecar of the removed tarball
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/cni-plugins-linux-amd64-*.tgz  # extracted into /opt/cni/bin at build time
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/cni-plugins-linux-amd64-*.tgz.sha256  # sidecar of the removed tarball
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/crictl-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz  # extracted to /usr/bin/crictl at build time
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/crictl-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz.sha256  # sidecar of the removed tarball
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/helm-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz  # extracted to /usr/bin/helm at build time
removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/helm-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz.sha256  # sidecar of the removed tarball

# --- placeholder files ---------------------------------------------------------
removed /etc/kubernetes/manifests/.kubelet-keep  # dir ships empty: kubeadm's DirAvailable preflight counts hidden files as "not empty"
removed /var/lib/kubelet/.kubelet-keep  # dir ships empty, same reason

# --- what dpkg now lays down instead ----------------------------------------------
optional added /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/k8s-base-container-images_*_linux_amd64.tgz  # 1.36.3 only: production 1.36.3 shipped no image tarball; this build bundles images for every row
optional added /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/k8s-base-container-images_*_linux_amd64.tgz.sha256  # 1.36.3 only: sidecar of the above
added /usr/local/bin/containerd  # from the containerd release tarball, where its own unit expects it
added /usr/local/bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2  # from the containerd release tarball
added /usr/local/bin/ctr  # from the containerd release tarball; postinst imports the bundled images with it
added /opt/cni/bin/*  # the CNI plugins, extracted at build time
added /usr/bin/crictl  # extracted at build time
added /usr/bin/helm  # extracted at build time
added /etc/containerd/config.toml  # rendered at build time: config v3, SystemdCgroup, sandbox pinned to the locked pause image
added /etc/containerd/conf.d/  # supported local-override path (config.toml imports conf.d/*.toml)
added /etc/crictl.yaml  # rendered at build time
added /etc/cni/net.d/  # containerd's conf_dir; shipped so containerd does not log CNI errors until something creates it
added /etc/cni/  # parent of net.d
added /opt/cni/  # parent of bin
added /opt/  # parent of cni
added /usr/local/  # parent of bin
added /usr/local/bin/  # parent
added /etc/containerd/  # parent
added /lib/systemd/system/containerd.service  # containerd's own v2.3.0 unit, shipped instead of written by the installer

# --- control fields ---------------------------------------------------------
# (peer rows in Conflicts/Replaces are excluded from the contract by debmanifest itself)
field Depends += conntrack, socat, ethtool  # kubeadm preflight: conntrack is a hard error without it; socat and ethtool are warnings
field Conflicts += containerd, containerd.io  # this package owns /usr/local/bin/containerd and its unit and config

# --- conffiles ----------------------------------------------------------------
conffiles += /etc/default/kubelet  # operator KUBELET_EXTRA_ARGS survive a row switch; production shipped the file without marking it
